exams.name: Fundamentals of Engineering (Engineer-in-Training) Examination
exams.notes: First stage of the two-stage examination; tests knowledge of fundamental engineering subjects including mathematics and basic sciences. May be taken after four years of required experience or upon achieving senior standing.
exams.quote: The first stage of the examination shall test the applicant's knowledge of appropriate fundamentals of engineering subjects, including mathematics and the basic sciences.

exams.name: Professional Engineering Examination (Principles and Practice)
exams.notes: Second stage of the two-stage examination; tests ability to apply knowledge and experience in the field of specific training and qualifications. May be taken after completion of required eight years of experience.
exams.quote: This stage of the examination shall test the applicant's ability, upon the basis of his or her greater experience, to apply his or her knowledge and experience in the field of his or her specific training and qualifications.

exams.name: Structural Engineering Examination
exams.notes: Additional examination required for structural engineering specialty registration, beyond the standard PE examination.
exams.quote: An applicant for registration as a structural engineer must also pass an additional examination as prescribed by the board.

interval_years.quote: Certificates of registration, and certificates of authorization and renewals thereof, shall expire on the last day of the month of December following their issuance or renewal and shall become invalid on that date unless renewed.

required.quote: Beginning July 1, 2007, the board may not renew a certificate of registration for a land surveyor unless the registrant verifies to the board that he or she has completed at least fifteen hours of continuing professional development per year of the registration period.

requirements.value: Applicant must meet all requirements of this chapter and board rules, be in good standing with the licensing agency in the other jurisdiction, and the other jurisdiction's requirements must not be lower than Washington's. disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, paying, or accepting a substantial gift, bribe, or other consideration to influence the award of professional work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provisions of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provisions of this chapter
